# ADIF 3.1.7 export vocabulary oracle

`adx317.xsd.gz` is the unmodified official ADIF 3.1.7.0 export schema, dated 2026-03-09, fetched from https://adif.org/317/adx317.xsd during the independent verification. It is copied byte-for-byte from the frozen review evidence. The uncompressed SHA-256 is `ce7a86832f7be4a232d2c1ae7432925feb2be8506cba24345b7e3ad994a87331` (49,104 bytes).

The ADX regression checks exported RECORD element names against this independent schema vocabulary. It also checks USERDEF declarations and preserved values. This is not full XSD validation: the original schema contains an unrelated NZ regex lookahead that libxml2 rejects. The review evidence describes that limitation and the narrowly relaxed auxiliary schema used for separate validation; the test fixture here is unmodified.
